tools.name: submit_product
tools.description: Submit a website to VibeHacker. Reads the site, drafts the listing, and files it for review. Requires a token. If the website was already submitted, returns the existing listing instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: preview_product
tools.description: Draft a listing for a website without submitting it. Requires a token.

tools.name: my_submissions
tools.description: List the products you submitted and their review status. Requires a token.

tools.name: upvote_product
tools.description: Toggle your upvote on a product. Requires a token.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search published products by name, tagline, or maker.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: my_submissions · Private data: submit_product, preview_product, my_submissions, upvote_product · Public sink: submit_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: my_submissions · Private data: submit_product, preview_product, my_submissions, upvote_product · Public sink: submit_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
